purpose: Resolves retailer display names recorded by different acquisition waves to one canonical name per retailer, so that a single retailer cannot appear as two distinct sellers.
rationale: Any derivation that compares or aggregates across sellers depends on the seller name identifying a real, distinct retailer. Where one retailer carries two names, that retailer corroborates itself: a point resting on a single retailer is counted as resting on two, and a cross-seller median is computed over what is really one seller's price. This file records the mapping additively. The observation tranches are immutable and are never edited to apply it.

resolutions.basis: Both names denote cclonline.com. 'CCL Computers' appears on two observations from the 2026-08-10T040544Z backfill wave; 'CCL Online' is the name used by the 2026-08-11 multi-retailer wave and matches the retailer's own domain and trading name.
resolutions.evidence: Both affected observations collide exactly with a CCL Online observation of the same MPN in the same calendar month at the same price (KF560C30BBEK2-32 in 2025-09 and KF564C32RSK2-32 in 2025-06, each GBP 113.99). Left unresolved, each of those months would have reported two contributing retailers in perfect agreement when only one retailer was observed.

roster_rule: Every seller display name present in the observations must resolve to a name on this roster. A name that does not is rejected rather than admitted as a new retailer, so that a future alias cannot silently become an additional seller and inflate cross-seller agreement.
